How to Play

Choose 2 or 4 players, select your relationship type, then choose a relationship deck. The active player taps the deck, scratches the silver area to reveal the question, and everyone discusses it. Tap Next Card when you are finished. The played card moves to the face-up pile and the turn moves to the next player.
